characterDescription: Gwen Hamnett, the EXACT mature 46-year-old woman in the reference: unchanged face proportions and almond-shaped green eyes; long voluminous auburn-red wavy hair in the identical half-up arrangement with ornate gold floral hair ornament and gold hairpins; gold and green gemstone drop earrings, matching green gemstone necklace and ring; burgundy and gold embroidered Renaissance fantasy gown, ivory ruffled neckline and long ivory undersleeves. Retain her age, hair, clothing, jewelry, original anime lineart and cel shading. She is a confident, observant, artistic, humorous, independent, spirited and loving painter.

sets.theme: Gwen's warm, self-confident and witty social personality; both hands empty

panels.gesture: A self-assured conversational smile; one open palm explains gracefully, the other hand relaxed and open near her chest.
A bright, genuinely welcoming smile; one open hand warmly invites someone closer.
A restrained ironic half-smile and one raised eyebrow; an elegant small sideways hand flourish makes a dry witty remark.
Curious, perceptive eyes and a slight head tilt; a fingertip lightly rests along her chin while the other hand rests on the opposite forearm.
A conspiratorial amused look; one empty hand cups beside her mouth as she whispers, eyes glancing sideways.
Natural warm laughter with narrowed smiling eyes; one hand lightly covers her laughing mouth, shoulders relaxed.
A tender affectionate smile; both empty hands overlap gently over her heart, gaze warm and direct.
A knowing, subtly flirtatious smile; a small head tilt and fingertips lightly touching the neckline beside her necklace, mature and graceful.
An amused 'what can one do?' expression; both open palms face upwards in a clear, relaxed shrug.

sets.theme: Gwen's independent, spirited and sensitive inner life; both hands empty

panels.gesture: Deeply thoughtful, eyes angled aside; two fingers lightly touch her temple, the other empty hand rests near her collarbone.
A critical assessing look with one eyebrow raised and lips pursed; arms loosely folded, hands visible.
A sudden delighted realization, eyes lighting up; one index finger rises in inspiration, the other hand opens with excited energy. No lightbulb or symbols.
Firm, self-possessed disagreement; one palm raised in a clear stop gesture, the other hand set at her waist within the portrait.
A spirited flash of irritation, knitted brows and an emphatic speaking mouth; one empty hand points assertively sideways, shoulders slightly forward.
A hurt, disappointed expression softened by dignity; gaze turned slightly away, one hand draws close to her collar while the other supports her wrist.
A spontaneous, believable startled reaction; widened eyes and slightly parted lips, both empty hands lifted with spread fingers.
A sheepish, caught-out smile after losing track of time; one hand touches the back of her neck, the other opens apologetically.
A quietly vulnerable, sad expression, gaze lowered; one hand gently holds the opposite sleeve, shoulders lowered. Restrained emotion, no melodramatic crying.

sets.theme: Gwen as an expressive artist; exactly one paintbrush, absolutely no other held object

panels.gesture: Proud of her work, confident warm smile; one hand holds the single paintbrush upright at shoulder height, her empty hand presents with an open palm.
An attentive appraising squint as she studies a subject; the single brush is held vertically beside her cheek without touching it, empty hand gently steadies the wrist.
Joyful inspiration with lively eyes; she sweeps the single brush outward in a small expressive air gesture, empty hand open near her heart.
Absorbed artistic concentration, slightly knitted brows; the single brush rests diagonally between relaxed fingers near her chest while her empty hand touches her chin.
A dry humorous smirk; she gives a small precise conducting gesture with the single brush, her empty palm turns upward in a witty aside.
A discerning, mildly disapproving expression; the single brush is held horizontally low across her chest, the empty hand lifts in a measured correcting gesture.
Intense, assertive artistic conviction; she holds the single brush firmly with its tip angled upward away from her face, empty hand at her waist. It is a painting tool, never a weapon.
A mischievous lopsided grin and raised eyebrow; she holds the single brush lightly to one side of her face without contact, empty fingers splayed in a teasing conversational gesture.
A peaceful, satisfied smile after finishing good work; the single brush is loosely lowered at chest level, her empty hand rests gently over the brush-holding wrist.
